name: Google Gemini image (Nano Banana) and Imagen
description: Gemini image models ('Nano Banana' family) via @google/genai; Imagen 4 retired in 2026.

restrictions: Imagen 4 endpoints retired (Firebase page says 2026-06-24; Gemini API table via secondary sources says 2026-08-17)

cost.notes: No free tier for image models (pricing page 2026-11-14): Nano Banana 2.1 USD 0.0336 per 1K image, Flash Lite Image USD 0.0336.

verdictReason: Cheap and good, but models churn fast; the author's 'Imagen' is retired, use the Gemini image models.
